header.name: MES-NS-NetSuite: Query Customer Return Authorization
header.description: Netsuite Customer Return Authorization import flow, listens for request from MES-NS-NetSuite Inbound Flow with record data posted from Netsuite, using record id additional details are queried from Netsuite and created in Fuuz DB

branches.name: EMPTY REQUEST
branches.transform: $isNilOrEmpty($.REQUEST)
true
branches.name: PASS

nodes.name: Mutate: CREATE MSG FAILURE NO DATA

branches.name: RECEIVED/BILLED/CLOSED
branches.transform:
$state.context.LOCAL.trx[mainline = 'T'].status in ["F","G","H"]
and
$isNotNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.fztrx)
/*
Return Authorization:Pending Refund   <===>   RtnAuth:F
Return Authorization:Refunded   <===>   RtnAuth:G
Return Authorization:Closed   <===>   RtnAuth:H 
*/

branches.name: MISSING OBJECTS
branches.transform:
$isNotNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failP)
or
$isNotNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failC)
or
$isNotNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failU)
or
$isNotNilOrEmpty($state.context.LOCAL.failF)

$state.context.LOCAL.trx[mainline = 'T'].status = "B"
/*
Return Authorization:Pending Approval   <===>   RtnAuth:A
Return Authorization:Pending Receipt   <===>   RtnAuth:B 
*/
branches.name: RELEASED
BAD STATUS
branches.transform:
true
/* 
Pending Approval   <===>   RtnAuth:A
Pending Receipt   <===>   RtnAuth:B
Cancelled   <===>   RtnAuth:C
Partially Received   <===>   RtnAuth:D
Pending Refund/Partially Received   <===>   RtnAuth:E
Pending Refund   <===>   RtnAuth:F
Refunded   <===>   RtnAuth:G
Closed   <===>   RtnAuth:H
*/

nodes.name: Netsuite REST: UPDATE TRX Sync Error

data.transform:
return `
SELECT 
    * 
  FROM transactionstatus
  WHERE BUILTIN.DF(trantype)='Return Authorization'

`

data.responseTransform: "Enable Netsuite in the MES Application Configuration to use this functionality"

data.transform:
return `
SELECT 
  t.*,
  l.*
  i.itemtype
FROM 
  transaction t
LEFT JOIN transactionline l 
  ON t.id=l.transaction 
LEFT JOIN item i
  ON i.id=l.item
WHERE
  t.id = ${$state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id}
  AND
  l.taxline='F'
    AND
  t.type = 'RtnAuth'

`

branches.name: NO DATA
branches.transform: $count(data)<=0

branches.name: Expenses Included
Unsupported Item Type
Valid
branches.transform: true
